generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
The contractor is responsible for safety and security of all materials.
It is the responsibility of the contractor to pursue and obtain all necessary approvals.

As per Karnataka State Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and G.No. PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted welfare fund.
Conditional Tenders will not be accepted.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of tender for physical verification.
The tenderer shall scan the original ownership document/ lease / hire commitment Agreement scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Tender.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
The tenderer should not damage the building while execution If any damages made, tenderer should make good of it from his own cost.
The start date for this work has to be considered from the date of issue of work order.
Tenderers must provide insurance to all the employees executing this work.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.
The Laboures deployed shall mandatory wear the face mask, Electrical safety hand gloves and take all safety measures to protect laboures and staff.
The Agency should consider necessary ladder etc., required for fixing electrical items.
The agency considers all labours required for fixing items.
The agency should inspect the site before quoting the tender.

Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill.
